Class DatavalidFaceVerifier

Namespace
NuvTools.Security.Biometrics.Serpro
Assembly
NuvTools.Security.Biometrics.Serpro.dll

Verifies a captured face through SERPRO Datavalid, which compares it with the face on government record for the CPF. The credentials and the token never leave the server.
